set.body:
Discovered 2026-10-03 when landing the local integration line (PR #15, integration/merge-local-main-20261003 at 4412a339 = local main fa6bd6a9 + conflict-free merge of origin/main). The local line has never run on hosted CI. All three hosted jobs fail on the same 2 of 266 design tests (run 37085608577); everything else passes. Both tests pass locally on the identical commit (macOS arm64, JDK 22). The merge is not the cause: the design module does not depend on the changed pins.

1. DesignIdentitySuite "single-run, two-run and FIR structural identities have shared literal goldens" (line 15): exactFingerprintGoldens("two") expected design-schema/v2:93615b2e435af535, CI obtained design-schema/v2:9bf0fcafe7f8865c.
2. DesignIdentitySuite "realistic SPMG structural identity is distinct from its numerical content" (line 64): "SPMG value differs by more than one ULP: 4592480243847689708 vs 4592480243847689710" (2 ULP).

Cause: DesignFingerprint deliberately hashes exact matrix bits and rank-diagonal bits (DesignSchema.scala ~703: "an identity of exact matrix contents"). SPMG1 columns come from transcendental math (exp/gamma). java.lang.Math may differ by ~1 ULP across CPU/JDK, compounding to 2 ULP here. The literal goldens were captured on one platform (from commits 4ea837ac "pin shared structural and exact-content goldens" and 4a5d4697 "Pin rank audit inputs in the cross-platform fingerprint fixture", merged as c05a0811 "Merge qualified HRF/design identity v2"), so they cannot hold on hosted CI.

Options, a maintainer decision (tests must not simply be loosened):
(a) Make the HRF/design numerics bit-deterministic: StrictMath (fdlibm) on JVM, and confirm Scala.js agreement, which uses JS Math.
(b) Keep exact-content fingerprint goldens only for fixtures whose values are exact on every platform (FIR/boxcar). For SPMG, assert structural identity and a documented cross-platform ULP bound.
(c) Per-platform goldens. Not recommended.
Until resolved, PR #15 cannot pass hosted CI.
set.title: Design identity v2 exact goldens are not reproducible on CI (Linux x86-64, Java 17); blocks landing local main (PR #15)
